title: PARKlifeTM: At the Intersection of Work and Play
summary: In 2018, workers at a UK Prologis logistics park gave feedback that they wished they had space near their workplace where they could enjoy wildlife and fresh air on their breaks.
body_markdown:
In


[Le Havre, France](https://www.prologis.com/industrial-properties/france/le-havre-atlantic-coast-port-center) , Parc du Hode introduced its first pétanque court – a common French outdoor game. The newly opened area was celebrated with an event that brought together the Prologis Customer Experience Team and our French customers to compete in friendly pétanque matches.


Just outside


[Madrid, Spain](https://www.prologis.com/industrial-properties/spain/madrid-spains-business-and-political-capital) , Prologis Park Alcalá installed Padel Courts to host friendly tournaments among employees. The park also hosts events like a running club, nutritional workshops, and frequent volunteer opportunities like food drives and blood donation campaigns.


Recreational areas inside Prologis Park,


[Hungary](https://www.prologisce.eu/news-research/articles/se-cee-schneider-take-home-victory-prologis-budapest-football-tournament) ,


[Prologis Park Prague-Rudna](https://www.prologisce.eu/news-research/articles/festival-football-and-music-prologis-parks-prague) , Czech Republic or


[Prologis Park Łódź](https://www.prologisce.eu/news-research/articles/first-football-tournament-prologis-park-lodz) , Poland offer opportunities for customers to host football tournaments – a coveted customer tradition since 2014.


Prologis parks in


[Seattle, Washington (U.S.)](https://www.prologis.com/industrial-properties/united-states/warehouses-lease-seattle-washington) **** are home to more than 37,000 honeybees. Just outside of


[Paris, France](https://www.prologis.com/industrial-properties/france/paris-europes-largest-logistics-real-estate-market) , beehives help collect information that measures the quality of biodiversity on a given site. In both locations, the honey is harvested and shared with customers. In


[Poland](https://www.prologisce.eu/news-research/articles/new-hedgehog-homes-prologis-parks) , it’s not uncommon to find hedgehogs around our sites. Our local teams have built and installed 25 hedgehog homes to house the protected species over the winter.
